sentences.text:
Harsh Vardhan Goyal & Ors vs Unknown on 5 March, 2026
05.03.2026
Item No.43
Ct. No. 34
 nb
 Crr 58 of 2026

In the matter of: Harsh Vardhan Goyal & Ors.
 ...... Petitioners.

Mr. Soumya Nag
 Mr. Aditya Tiwari
 Mr. Soham Sen

This revisional application has been filed for quashing of the proceeding pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 3 rd Court, Howrah arising out of Golabari Police Station Case No.114 of 2023 dated 24.04.2023 under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel representing the petitioner/husband submits that admittedly the opposite party no.2 is not living with the present petitioner since 2020, which was observed by the Coordinate Bench at the time of granting of order of anticipatory bail.
Subsequently, a suit for mutual divorce was also filed and was decreed, despite the same proceeding is pending.

3. In this regard, relying upon a decision in the case of Mohd. Shamim & Ors. Vs. Nahid Begum (Smt.) & Anr. reported in (2005) 3 SCC 302.
4.

entities.text: Mohd. Shamim & Ors. Vs. Nahid Begum (Smt.) & Anr. reported in (2005) 3 SCC 302
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, it appears that an arguable case has been made and for which, matter is required to be heard.

5. Let the matter be listed four weeks hence.
6.
In the meantime, further proceeding of the instant case be stayed till April 30, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(CHAITALI CHATTERJEE (DAS), J.)
